arguments.heading: What happened at the argument
paragraphs: Mr. Cole argues the claims are not about prison conditions.
Mr. Lewis argues the Heck rule applies straightforwardly.
Justice Scalia questions if a habeas action fits this claim.
Justice Souter notes the lack of a clear durational consequence.

sections.heading: What this case is about
paragraphs: Prisoners lost good-time credits due to a procedural error. They sue for damages. The state says they must prove the error caused a longer stay.
